rules.title: No process-global state outliving a session
rules.text: N9: "The server holds no cross-session memory. Caches are keyed by content hash and are never a source of truth" (PROTOCOL.md §1).

judgement.question: Is this process-global state that outlives a document or a session — a `static mut`, a `OnceLock`/`LazyLock`/`lazy_static` cell or a `thread_local!` — rather than a `const` table, an import, per-session state the server owns, or a fixture?

criteria.true: a static or thread-local holds state the code consults across requests — a cache, buffer, counter or singleton that outlives the session, so two editors sharing the process would share it
criteria.false: it is a `const` or other compile-time table, an `use` line, state owned by the session's own state object, a doc comment, or test code
